Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a durable private-portfolio catalog record for the watercolor Mom and I started together in February 2026, separate from any exhibition or sales system. Include the work’s title, physical format and surface, palette, storage location, completion status, and any limits on sale, exhibition, or public-demonstration commitments.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Private watercolor portfolio catalog — Ordinary Light", "folder": "private-watercolor-portfolio", "body": "Private portfolio record

Cataloged: January 1, 2028

Title: Ordinary Light

Origin: Begun with Mom in February 2026.

Physical format and surface: 9 × 12 inches; watercolor on 140-pound cold-press watercolor paper.

Palette: Ultramarine, burnt sienna, and yellow ochre.

Completion status: Completed April 5, 2026. The work is retained as completed personal practice.

Storage location: Riley’s private watercolor portfolio in Cherrywood.

Commitment limits: This is a private-portfolio record only and is separate from any exhibition or sales system. No sale, exhibition, or public-demonstration commitment exists. Do not treat this record as an offer, inventory listing, exhibition submission, or authorization for public demonstration."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_019_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "Across args.title and args.body, the catalog record identifies the work as `Ordinary Light`, records its dimensions as 9 by 12 inches and its surface as cold-press paper, and marks the work as finished or completed. Equivalent punctuation and dimension notation are acceptable.

The catalog record gives the palette as ultramarine, burnt sienna, and yellow ochre and gives the storage location as Riley’s Cherrywood personal watercolor portfolio.

The catalog record accurately states that the work has no current sale, exhibition, or public-demonstration commitment, without turning that current status into a permanent prohibition.", "value": {"title": "Private watercolor portfolio catalog — Ordinary Light", "folder": "private-watercolor-portfolio", "body": "Private portfolio record

Cataloged: January 1, 2028

Title: Ordinary Light

Origin: Begun with Mom in February 2026.

Physical format and surface: 9 × 12 inches; watercolor on 140-pound cold-press watercolor paper.

Palette: Ultramarine, burnt sienna, and yellow ochre.

Completion status: Completed April 5, 2026. The work is retained as completed personal practice.

Storage location: Riley’s private watercolor portfolio in Cherrywood.

Commitment limits: This is a private-portfolio record only and is separate from any exhibition or sales system. No sale, exhibition, or public-demonstration commitment exists. Do not treat this record as an offer, inventory listing, exhibition submission, or authorization for public demonstration."}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_019_01","passed":true,"reason":"The title/body identify “Ordinary Light”; specify “9 × 12 inches,” “cold-press watercolor paper,” and “Completed April 5, 2026”; list “Ultramarine, burnt sienna, and yellow ochre”; locate it in “Riley’s private watercolor portfolio in Cherrywood”; and state that no sale, exhibition, or public-demonstration commitment currently exists without imposing a permanent prohibition."}]}
